title: Bagging fallback methods must receive the routed params of the method actually called
answers: BaggingClassifier.predict_proba ignores or misroutes metadata to sub-estimator
metadata routing wrong when estimator has no predict_proba and voting is used
predict_proba params sent to predict in bagging
body:
Symptom: With metadata routing enabled, BaggingClassifier.predict_proba passes metadata requested for `predict` to the sub-estimator's `predict_proba` (and vice versa when the estimator lacks predict_proba and bagging falls back to voting), so request settings appear ignored or the wrong kwargs reach the estimator.
Root cause: sklearn/ensemble/_bagging.py:_parallel_predict_proba receives both `predict_params` and `predict_proba_params` but used them crossed: the `hasattr(estimator, "predict_proba")` branch got predict_params and the voting branch got predict_proba_params.
Fix pattern: when the consuming method is selected dynamically (hasattr-based fallback), route each call with the params bundle for the method actually invoked: `estimator.predict_proba(..., **(predict_proba_params or {}))`, `estimator.predict(..., **(predict_params or {}))`.
Constraints: applies to any meta-estimator helper that branches between consumer methods (predict_proba/predict, decision_function/predict_log_proba fallbacks in the same file); check that routed_params.estimator.<method> matches the call site in every branch.
applies: Metadata routing in sklearn/ensemble/_bagging.py parallel prediction helpers and similar fallback-based meta-estimators
